description: This file is a shell script used for testing session ID capabilities in a Git repository setup. It contains setup commands, test cases for fetching and pushing with session ID advertisement enabled, and verifies the presence or absence of session IDs in trace logs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive string and a series of commands.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test case finishes.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit in a given repository with specified changes.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.
